result.summary:
INT-offline-lease adversary vs 2994371e (attacked_sha = git rev-parse HEAD = 2994371e1c5edf9a1e9bb12f6c6e4751e3fb4ea1). Attack branch devin/pp/adv/offline-lease-2994371e @ d3332d9b50cf7b0aba3aacb1df90a9f6afeabcc5 adds ONLY two new test files under supabase/functions/api/__wf__/ (no production code, no existing test, no migration touched; no PR opened; no force push). Area at this HEAD (VERIFIED by ls/grep): apps/mobile/src/offline and apps/mobile/src/access do not exist, apps/mobile/src and supabase/functions/api/index.ts contain no reference to offline grants/tickets/device registration — the offline-lease surface is SQL (supabase/migrations/20260908160000_offline_device_grants.sql), shared validators (packages/shared-types/src/offlineAuthorization.ts) and the Edge signer/verifier (supabase/functions/api/offlineSignature.ts). No Jest attack was written because nothing in the shipping app calls the area yet.

ENV (VERIFIED): Node v24.19.0, pnpm 10.15.1, Deno 2.9.6, disposable `docker run postgres:16` at 127.0.0.1:55433 with shim_auth.sql + every migration applied via __wf__/xc_pg_up.sh. Production Supabase, App Store Connect, RevenueCat and the Mac runner were never touched.

BASELINE (VERIFIED): `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && XC_PG_URL=postgres://postgres:pg@127.0.0.1:55433/postgres deno test -A --no-check --config deno.json w04_01_offline_grants_concurrency.test.ts` -> exit 0, 5 executed / 5 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped (artifact baseline_w0401.log, attachment 1).

ATTACK RUN A — Postgres (VERIFIED): `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && XC_PG_URL=postgres://postgres:pg@127.0.0.1:55433/postgres deno test -A --no-check --config deno.json xc_pg_offline_lease_w0401_adversary.test.ts` -> exit 1, 8 executed / 7 passed / 1 failed / 0 skipped (artifact pg_final.log, attachment 2). The tests are `ignore`d without XC_PG_URL — such a run is NOT a pass. Held (passing attacks):
- OL2-PG-1 allocation ≠ consumption / repeated actions: two tickets returned unused write no shot and no consumed event, lifetime_scored_count()=0; returned tickets remain holds (offline_hold_count()=2, reserved_count=2) so reserve_analysis_permit and issue_offline_grant answer access.paywall_required with a code (never raise); double release is an idempotent 'accepted', consume-after-release -> offline.ticket_released, a direct superuser second terminal ledger row -> SQLSTATE 23514 from guard_offline_ledger_event; ledger stays allocated>released.
- OL2-PG-3 expired lease at settlement: a ticket whose grant expired 33 days ago (owner-role backdate of offline_grants.issued_at/expires_at) is still consumable and charged; the hold is never reclaimed. Passing = documents current behaviour; see design notes.
- OL2-PG-4 corrupted / malformed settlement payloads (bad uuid, score > 10, confidence > 1, garbage / out-of-range capturedAt, non-numeric ms, phases not an array, missing version vector, 'scored' with no score): each refused with a returned code, no shot, no ledger event, ticket still outstanding; corrected retry settles exactly once.
- OL2-PG-5 conservation under contention: 3 issue_offline_grant lanes + 3 reserve_analysis_permit lanes from one barrier -> outstanding tickets + live reservations ≤ 2, no lane raised.
- OL2-PG-6 account switch on one installation key: second account cannot consume/release/see the first account's tickets even after registering the SAME installation key; first account's tickets untouched on return.
- OL2-PG-7 Pro leases at the table: expires_at = min(now+7d, verified expiry) for a subscription expiring in 1h / 30d, exactly 7d for lifetime (entitlement_expires_at null), ticket_ids empty for Pro; free tickets allocated before subscribing stay outstanding, consumable and counted after the entitlement lapses.
- OL2-PG-8 conflicting server state: a shot already synced online under a permit presented under a ticket -> offline.shot_not_chargeable, ticket stays outstanding; an offline-settled shot re-synced online is a replay that leaves the permit untouched.
Broke: OL2-PG-2 (breaks[2]).

ATTACK RUN B — validators / crypto (VERIFIED): `cd supabase/functions/api && deno test --no-prompt --frozen --lock=deno.lock __wf__/xc_offline_lease_crypto_adversary_r2.test.ts` -> exit 1, 6 executed / 4 passed / 2 failed / 0 skipped (artifact crypto_final.log, attachment 3; also type-checks: `deno check --frozen --lock=deno.lock __wf__/xc_offline_lease_crypto_adversary_r2.test.ts` exit 0). Held:
- OL2-CR-3 header/algorithm confusion: alg=none (empty and junk signature) -> invalid_transport / invalid_metadata; HS256 keyed with the public JWK x||y -> invalid_metadata; HMAC under a swapped ES256 header -> invalid_signature; extra protected-header members crit/b64=false (raw-signed), jku, x5u, cty -> invalid_metadata; typ missing / 'JWT' -> invalid_metadata; kid naming another loaded key -> invalid_signature; token-only kid -> invalid_metadata; duplicate `sub` JSON key binds to the expected owner.
- OL2-CR-4 key rotation fails closed: grant under a retired kid refused (invalid_metadata) once the kid leaves allowedKeyIds even while its key is loaded; a loaded key outside the allowlist poisons the whole set (invalid_key) rather than being ignored; duplicate kids, empty key set, a signing-key object or a private JWK presented for verification -> invalid_key; same kid with different material -> invalid_signature; the rotated grant verifies.
- OL2-CR-5 clock rollback at verification: now = iat-1, iat-30d, exactly exp, fractional, -0, NaN, 2^53, a forged future iat, minting with a rolled-back or already-expired server clock -> invalid_time; now = iat and exp-1 verify (clockTolerance 0, inclusive iat / exclusive exp).
- OL2-CR-6 reconciliation with conflicting server state (validateOfflineReconciliationStatus, 27 cases): a pending ticketed receipt is only 'reserved'; a chargeable result is 'consumed' only for its own resultId; a not_chargeable result is never 'consumed' or 'returned'; a Pro (ticketless) result is only 'not_applicable'; an unused-ticket return can never become result_recorded and a result receipt never unused_ticket_returned; reconciliation_required / support_review keep the hold ('reserved') and refuse 'consumed'/'returned' and unknown reason codes; owner / receiptId mismatch and extra fields refuse.
Broke: OL2-CR-1 (breaks[0]), OL2-CR-2 (breaks[1]).

FORMAT/LINT (VERIFIED, new files only): `npx prettier --check supabase/functions/api/__wf__/xc_*.test.ts` exit 0; `npx eslint <both files>` exit 0; `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && deno lint --config deno.json <both files>` exit 0.

NOT A BREAK / DESIGN NOTES for the coordinator (INFERRED from migration comments, VERIFIED behaviour): (a) returning an unused ticket is by design not a re-credit (migration §4) — an identity that allocates two tickets and returns both unused has rendered zero ratings and is permanently at the paywall (OL2-PG-1 pins this); the coordinator should confirm this matches 'partial/failed/withheld results never consume a credit' since a hold and a consumed credit are indistinguishable to the user here. (b) consume_offline_ticket accepts a ticket whose grant expired long ago (OL2-PG-3): the ledger takes no execution-window evidence; with free-grant exp unbounded (breaks[1]) and no receipt path wired at this HEAD, nothing server-side proves a free offline rating was rendered inside a lease window. (c) Earlier-round findings OL-CR-1/OL-CR-2 on branch devin/pp/adv/offline-lease-30a40650 were re-derived independently here against 2994371e; they are still present at this head.

NOT_YET_VERIFIABLE (never guessed): device-side offline authorization, Keychain/secure-enclave installation key attestation (App Attest), native trusted time (ios_mach_continuous_time anchor), clock rollback on a real device, process death / relaunch / network loss mid-settlement in the iOS app, missing camera/photo permissions and missing media, StoreKit / RevenueCat Pro entitlement -> lease issuance end to end. None of this exists in apps/mobile at 2994371e (VERIFIED absent) and none can run on Linux. When the mobile wiring lands, the Mac/device run required is: `scripts/mac-full-verify.sh` on the M4 runner (coordinator-owned; do NOT run `--remote` from an adversary session), i.e. on the Mac: `cd apps/mobile && npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest --silent __tests__/adv/`, then `scripts/mac-full-verify.sh` (which runs `xcodebuild test` for the native packages on macOS + an iOS Simulator and `xcodebuild build -workspace apps/mobile/ios/PickleSensei.xcworkspace` for the app), and a StoreKit-sandbox session on a physical iPhone (Settings → Developer → Sandbox Apple Account) for the Pro entitlement → lease path.

COUNTS: attacks_tried = 14 distinct attack tests (8 Postgres + 6 validator/crypto), 14 executed, 11 passed, 3 failed (= 3 confirmed breaks), 0 skipped.
